notes: Budgets set by the Technical Director, 2026-09-29, for 24 bouncing sprites, 0-3 pinned, in a DEBUG build. Schema and rationale: engine/README.md#budget-files and #multiplexer-costs. Main-loop routines use profile_excl_irq so zone IRQs landing inside them don't count against them. 'estimate' budgets are replaced with measured figures by the raster-engineer (engine/README.md#estimates-to-measure-in-m3).

checks.source: engine/README.md#multiplexer-costs: ~24 x 25 compares + shifts for a nearly sorted list

checks.name: all IRQ time per frame
checks.source: engine/README.md#frame-budget: ~640 top + 16 zone IRQs x (78 framework overhead, measured parts + counted irq_rearm 41, + ~60 per slot) + ~100 game entry = ~2,950; 3,300 keeps ~350 for the unmeasured per-slot cost and DMA inside the IRQs. Raster span, DMA included
